features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: Your Circle of the Sea spells are always prepared and don't count against your limit.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.desc: Your Wrath of the Sea aura grows; you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed and can breathe underwater.

features.name: Stormborn
features.desc: You gain a Fly Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage while you aren't underground.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.desc: You can extend Wrath of the Sea to an ally near you.
